final_text:
A live **agent status board** turns each of the ten agents into a compact, updating card that shows its current task, latest meaningful action, elapsed time since progress, and state: working, waiting, or possibly stuck.

The owner sees all ten cards at once, with waiting and stale agents surfaced; selecting a card reveals its recent activity and offers focused actions such as opening the conversation or nudging the agent. “Possibly stuck” is a signal based on stale progress, not a definitive diagnosis.

Unlike a log list, the board answers “who needs attention?” at a glance and lets the owner compare agents without reading each history. The main risk is misleading status: sparse or delayed activity can make a healthy agent look stuck, so show when the status was last updated and let the owner inspect the underlying activity.
